usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only identity anchors (UNDP administrator 2017–2025, Oxford Martin School) give a bare sketch of who Steiner is, with no evidence of what he actually did beyond the anchors. The single retained source is an unclassified Wikipedia excerpt with unattempted extraction, partial completeness, and unknown attribution, so nothing is verifiable in depth. No statements in the dossier make claims, so no overclaims can be cited; however, two listed unjustified conclusions (stale-as-current UNDP tenure; personal delivery of the SDGs) flag risks readers should keep in mind. The dossier never says what it does not know.
